card.name: Word starts that lead into 'fer' words
card.fires_on: Short word beginnings such as 'conf', 'F', 'f' or 'auf' where the next piece is likely to be 'fer' or 'er' (confers, interfere, Feraheme). Seen mostly in drug-label text, plus some other text.
